corrections.description: First pass calls a pea diagram; raw HTML has literal diag/ramme text and broken question layout, no actual image. Preserve four visible numbered groups without inventing a fifth.
First pass treats initiating paper as absent; footnote 2 reproduces Darwin questions and Babington additions. It is a separate manuscript witness requiring independent date and rendering treatment.
First pass invents third-plate location for unique P. semilatus; P3 is the third retained body block, not a plate statement.
First pass reads flattened MathML as twelve years; prior accepted full source confirms half-year accounts.
First pass merges P6 into Charles account; prior primary identifies Emma hand. Packing is prospective, not already completed.
First pass says five perfect plates; prior primary confirms one of five plates perfect.
First pass calls valves new to Darwin collection; prior primary states new to Fitch collection. Neither means new species.
Rich mud/dung analogues are appearances of the same A. angustifolia variety, not proof other species are identical.
An earlier Darwin inquiry is possible but not directly stated in this short report; do not assert an identified missing prompt or exact Darwin receipt.

summary: Nine targets: six Darwin outgoing and three incoming; no new direct, reverse or knowledge edge. Eleven fresh full-source readings and thirteen explicitly reused accepted contexts. Source authority-key search found no additional current incoming counterpart. Personal, financial and practical registers retained without subject exclusions. Four visible Fairbeard numbered groups and separate Babington question sheet held for rendering and dating.
